row.team_price_text: Growth: $265/month for 1 million events (monthly price; 15% off annually), unlimited team members
row.evidence: RudderStack's Okta SCIM guide states "The Single Sign-On (SSO) feature is available in the Enterprise plan only", SCIM is configured on that SSO app, and the pricing page lists SSO only under Enterprise (Contact sales).
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Pricing is event-volume based, not per user: Free $0 (250K events/month, 10 members), Growth from $265/month for 1M events (monthly price shown; page says save 15% with annual billing), Enterprise custom. SCIM (Okta OIN app and Entra via the generic https://api.rudderstack.com/scim/v2 endpoint) rides on Enterprise-only SAML SSO; Google Workspace and OneLogin are SAML/JIT only. SCIM creates, updates display name and deactivates (revokes the org role, keeps the user record); no delete and no group push. No member-management REST API; Audit Logs API is Enterprise.

plans.name: Growth
plans.price_text: $265/month for 1M events/month (scales with volume; 15% off with annual billing)
plans.notes: Flat, event-priced; unlimited team members. SSO and audit logs are not in Growth per the Enterprise card and docs.

auth.token_source: RudderStack dashboard: organization-level Service Access Token (Settings > Access tokens), pasted as the Okta API Token or Entra Secret Token

endpoints.notes: Paths are not documented; Users is inferred from documented user push. Group operations are 'coming soon'.

operations.notes: Updates are limited to display name; email changes are not supported. PUT vs PATCH not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: User record kept in RudderStack's database; only the organization user role is revoked, removing workspace access.

attributes.notes: Only display name is documented as updatable; email (Okta username format must be Email) cannot be changed via SCIM. No full attribute list is published.

limitations.text: No group push or group import; SCIM group operations are 'coming soon'.
Users cannot be removed via SCIM; unassigning deactivates instead.
Email address cannot be updated via SCIM; only display name.
Google Workspace integration is JIT-only, no SCIM.
Must use an organization-level Service Access Token or provisioning fails.

scim.notes: SCIM is configured on the customer's SAML SSO app (Okta OIN app or an Entra non-gallery app); SSO is Enterprise-only. RudderStack may need to switch SCIM on for the organization (Entra 403). Version 2.0 is read from the /scim/v2 base URL.

auth.notes: Service Access Tokens (organization or workspace level) and Personal Access Tokens authenticate the platform APIs.

user_api.notes: By absence: RudderStack's API index lists Audit Logs, Organization Usage, Data Catalog, Event Audit, User Suppression, HTTP, Pixel, Profiles, Reverse ETL Connections and Transformation APIs; none manages members, groups or roles. Members are managed in the dashboard.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup); Group Push, Sync Password, SWA and OIDC unchecked.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery app (Learn tutorial rudderstack-tutorial 404); RudderStack's guide uses a non-gallery SAML app plus automatic provisioning to the generic SCIM endpoint.

google.notes: Custom SAML app; JIT-only with group-based access via the SAML memberOf attribute. Deprovisioning is manual.

onelogin.notes: RudderStack's guide uses OneLogin's SAML Custom Connector (Advanced); no provisioning documented. OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace SAML group-based provisioning (memberOf attribute maps users to groups at sign-in)
